svg.aria-label: 目标联系，不表示充分精化
svg.text: 独立于成立精化；箭头按联系类型解释，状态逐项标明。

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
Select the search area by drawing a circle on a map instead of relying only on neighborhoo
d names. → Choose the neighborhood or area to search in before starting the keyword search
for that area.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 范围具体化
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 范围具体化
Pick a neighborhood close to a fixed destination such as a job or a college. → Choose the
neighborhood or area to search in before starting the keyword search for that area.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
Spot the neighborhoods where listings that fit the budget and requirements are clustered.
→ Choose the neighborhood or area to search in before starting the keyword search for that
area.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
Ask people who live in the target country for recommendations about places. → Choose the n
eighborhood or area to search in before starting the keyword search for that area.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
Search and use the full functionality without being required to register or log in, keepin
g registration optional for saving information. → Search the information I want convenient
ly, without steps I do not consider beneficial.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
See a timeline of the next steps and of what to expect after an inquiry, including what ha
ppens if it fails. → Keep all housing communication with property owners inside the websit
e, provided the process is clear and fast.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
Contact a provider with a short message instead of a long mandatory form and without handi
ng over all personal details up front. → Keep all housing communication with property owne
rs inside the website, provided the process is clear and fast.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
Reach a provider through their own website, email or phone found via the place name and Go
ogle Maps when the in-app contact gets no response. → Contact the people offering the shor
tlisted places to narrow the options down, letting reply speed, completeness of informatio
n and provider attitude affect the choice.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
Search listings by primary criteria: price range, size or bedroom and bathroom counts, and
home type. → Get an overview of the available options and price ranges, including reviews
and locations, when looking in a new market.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
Read reviews from people about a place so that it feels more trusted and the information s
its together. → Get an overview of the available options and price ranges, including revie
ws and locations, when looking in a new market.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
Include listings that did not specify a criterion when the user asks for it, for example t
hrough a checkbox, so that both confirmed and unspecified options are shown. → Avoid losin
g suitable options whose attributes the provider left unspecified when filtering.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 过程先后
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 过程先后
Narrow the results down with secondary criteria such as amenities, utilities, pet policy,
move-in date and how good the place looks. → Contact the people offering the shortlisted p
laces to narrow the options down, letting reply speed, completeness of information and pro
vider attitude affect the choice.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
Pick a specific available unit from the listed options instead of writing a custom message
. → Contact a provider with a short message instead of a long mandatory form and without h
anding over all personal details up front.
